purpose: Decompose equivalent-basis sensitivity into initialization mismatch and optimizer-induced function-space trajectory drift.

controlled.reference: joint train-whitened numerical-PLE, binary, and nominal-contrast coordinates
controlled.changed: the reference multiplied by a fixed scale-controlled invertible map

natural.reference: blockwise-whitened cumulative numerical PLE plus Helmert nominal contrasts
natural.changed: the exactly equivalent blockwise-whitened local PLE plus adjacent nominal contrasts

ordinary_adamw.initialization: identical parameter arrays in both coordinate systems

matched_adamw.initialization: changed first-layer weight is reference weight times inverse-transpose basis map
matched_adamw.role: optimizer sensitivity conditional on the same initial function

covariance_adamw.initialization: same-seed input-covariance-metric initialization fitted separately in each coordinate system
covariance_adamw.role: deployable initialization intervention; invariant in distribution, not necessarily paired

matched_input_natural.first_layer_update: full inverse augmented-input second moment with no ridge beyond numerical eigenvalue floor

ordinary_input_natural.initialization: identical parameter arrays in both coordinate systems
ordinary_input_natural.first_layer_update: full inverse augmented-input second moment with no ridge beyond numerical eigenvalue floor
ordinary_input_natural.role: diagnostic separating update invariance from initialization invariance

training.selection: none; final checkpoint is exactly update 200

primary_quantity: symmetric normalized RMS prediction drift between paired models on fixed train and validation probes

primary_hypotheses.H1: Function-matched AdamW has nonzero one-step orbit drift, demonstrating optimizer non-equivariance independently of initialization.
primary_hypotheses.H2: Early function-space orbit drift predicts final normalized paired performance harm better than input condition number alone.
primary_hypotheses.H3: Function matching materially reduces final sensitivity relative to ordinary AdamW, quantifying the initialization contribution.
primary_hypotheses.H4: Function-matched input-natural training remains near the same function trajectory and supplies a closure control.
primary_hypotheses.H5: The orbit-drift relationship transfers from controlled transforms to the natural cumulative/local pair.

failure_policy: Every requested pair is recorded; exceptions and nonfinite values are failures and are never silently dropped.
claim_boundary: This experiment does not claim that natural gradient, affine-invariant optimization, covariance initialization, or canonicalization is new. The candidate novelty is a function-space trajectory decomposition and a prospective early orbit-drift diagnostic for information-equivalent tabular schemas.
